title: 感性評価法
subtitle: Kansei Evaluation
educationalGoal: In a function of information processing, the one that emotion strongly affects is called "Kansei". Even as for the same stimulation, depending on your feelings, the processing result is different greatly. This subject deepens understanding with training for measuring and evaluating Kansei. For casual matters around us, students learn the technique of measurement and evaluation.
advice: The following topics will be covered: 1 Overview of psychophysics 2 Difference between Kansei evaluation and sensory evaluation 3 Semantic differentia method and method of quantitative descriptive ananlisys 4 Overview of perceptual judgment This course is required for Certified Psychologists.
requiredKnowledge: Review the contents of previous lectures on psychology, especially Introduction to Psychology and Psychological Experiments, thoroughly.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand psychophysics and its meaning.
Ability to perceptual judgment and its meaning.
Ability to understand the differences between Kansei evaluation and sensory evaluation.
Ability to use method of Kansei evaluation in the field of manufacturing.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
